scope: Synthetic-only contract for provider-account-aware cloud model quota admission. No provider credentials, provider calls, workflow dispatch, or gateway runtime.

identities.credential_reference: opaque secret reference only; never secret material
identities.independent_quota_rule: Credentials sharing the same provider_account_key share one quota unless provider-published terms explicitly establish separate entitlements.

required_atomicity.reservation: Compare-and-swap or serializable transaction over quota_scope; reserve before any outbound call.
required_atomicity.idempotency_key: Stable per task attempt; unique constraint prevents duplicate reservation.
required_atomicity.settlement: Exactly-once logical settlement; duplicate delivery returns the original settlement.
required_atomicity.uncertain_outcome: Transition to UNKNOWN and reconcile; do not release or retry against another account until policy-defined reconciliation proves safe.
required_atomicity.reset_rollover: Use provider-documented window boundaries and timezone; never infer reset from local midnight.

admission_checks: provider and account identity are verified
entitlement and plan are explicitly authorized and current
model and data classification are allowed
quota unit, limit, remaining amount, and reset boundary are known
route is active and not expired or revoked
cost class is FREE unless the exact task explicitly authorizes a paid route

response_policy.429: Honor Retry-After; update only the matching account/model/window; fallback only to a separately authorized provider account with its own available quota.
response_policy.401_or_403: Block route and fail closed; no credential cycling.
response_policy.timeout_after_send: Mark reservation UNKNOWN; reconcile before retry/fallback to prevent duplicate execution or quota overspend.
response_policy.provider_5xx_before_send: Release reservation only when transport proves request was not sent; otherwise UNKNOWN.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Two parallel workers reserve the last quota unit
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Exactly one reservation succeeds; the other is rejected; aggregate reservation never exceeds limit.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Two API keys belong to one provider account
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Both keys map to one quota_scope; no second quota is created.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Provider publishes independently metered entitlements for two accounts
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Separate quota scopes only when evidence records the provider terms and account identities.
Matching account/model/window enters cooldown until Retry-After; no early retry.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: 429 response has no Retry-After and reset is unknown
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Route BLOCKED or held until an explicit conservative retry policy; never assume quota reset.
Idempotent no-op; one settlement record and one quota decrement.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Timeout occurs after request may have reached provider
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Reservation becomes UNKNOWN; no automatic cross-provider retry until reconciliation.
Credential route BLOCKED; no repeated credential attempts.
New window opens only at provider-documented timestamp/timezone; prior window remains auditable.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Only remaining route is PAID and task permits FREE only
Credential reference is missing or secret value appears in evidence
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Admission denied or evidence validation fails; secret value never persisted.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Route is revoked while reservation is pending
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: No new outbound call; reservation is released only if not sent, otherwise UNKNOWN and reconciled.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Gateway returns fallback provider not in MediaHub allowlist
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject before outbound attempt; gateway cannot expand MediaHub authority.

synthetic_acceptance_cases.scenario: Ledger database unavailable or transaction outcome ambiguous
Same task attempt is retried with same idempotency key
synthetic_acceptance_cases.expected: Return existing reservation/result; no duplicate outbound request.

gateway_evaluation.LiteLLM: Potential transport adapter only. Must verify pinned release provenance, affected-advisory floors, DB/Redis fail-closed semantics and exact deployment configuration. Gateway budgets are not assumed to represent provider free quotas.
gateway_evaluation.Bifrost: Potential transport adapter only. Official repository is maximhq/bifrost (Apache-2.0); evaluate core and each separately versioned transport/plugin, routing allowlists, governance budget persistence and security advisories. Do not infer quota semantics from routing/health-based failover.
